description: Validates practical knowledge of security essentials, including active defense, network security, incident handling, cryptography, Linux security, and Windows security through GIAC's hands-on cybersecurity certification.
Demonstrates the ability to troubleshoot, configure, and manage wired and wireless networks, including networking concepts, infrastructure, security, operations, and cloud technologies.
Validates foundational knowledge of cybersecurity principles, including security principles, business continuity, access controls, network security, and security operations.
